description: MUTATES Autumn billing data — records a usage event (deducts/credits a feature balance). Provide EITHER feature_id OR event_name. Autumn API: POST /v1/balances.track.

event_name.description: Event name to track usage for. Provide this OR feature_id.

feature_id.description: The feature to track usage for. Provide this OR event_name.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional key to dedupe retried events.

properties.description: Additional properties to attach to the usage event.

timestamp.description: Unix timestamp (ms) for the event. Defaults to now.

value.description: Amount of usage to record. Defaults to 1. Negative values credit the balance.

name: track_usage
title: Track usage
